purpose: Curated origin-figure anchors for the long chronology. A person's lifetime, call, teaching period or movement role is kept distinct from the later institutional formation of a religion or school.
rules: Do not treat a founder, prophet, teacher or reformer as the sole birthday of a whole tradition.
Use ranges when chronology is contested.
Traditional and sacred chronologies must be labelled as such rather than silently presented as historical reconstruction.
A figure anchor may connect to several later lineage or foundation nodes.

events.title: Zarathustra / Zoroaster — prophet-associated reform
events.subject: Zarathustra / Zoroaster
events.place: eastern Iranian / Central Asian region, uncertain
events.summary: Zoroastrian tradition centers Zarathustra, but his historical date remains heavily disputed. The timeline therefore uses a wide band rather than one false exact year.

events.title: Mahavira — Jain teacher and community anchor
events.subject: Mahavira
events.summary: Mahavira is the central historical teacher associated with the Jain community's ancient formation, while Jain sacred chronology remembers earlier Tirthankaras.

events.title: The Buddha — teaching life and Sangha origin
events.subject: Siddhartha Gautama / the Buddha
events.summary: The historical Buddha's chronology is debated. His teaching career and the early Sangha belong on the timeline separately from later Buddhist schools and transmissions.

events.title: Confucius — Ru teaching lineage
events.subject: Confucius
events.summary: Confucius becomes a major teacher-anchor for the Ru/Confucian tradition; later state-linked and commentarial forms consolidate over centuries.

events.title: Jesus — teacher at the origin of the Jesus movement
events.subject: Jesus
events.summary: Jesus belongs to the Second Temple Jewish setting; the early Christian movement and its later institutions are shown as subsequent historical formations rather than collapsed into his lifespan.

events.title: Muhammad — prophetic career and early Islamic community
events.subject: Muhammad
events.summary: Muhammad's prophetic career is shown separately from the 610 revelation marker, the 622 Hijra and the later branching of Islamic legal and communal traditions.

events.title: Guru Nanak — Sikh teaching lineage begins
events.subject: Guru Nanak
events.summary: Guru Nanak's life and teaching anchor the early Sikh lineage; the Khalsa is a later 1699 refoundation marker rather than the same event.

events.title: George Fox — Quaker movement seed
events.subject: George Fox
events.summary: Fox's ministry and inward-light teaching belong before the movement's 1652 operating marker and later Quaker organization.

events.title: Joseph Smith — Latter-day Saint movement founder
events.subject: Joseph Smith
events.summary: Smith's life and revelations are distinct from the church's formal organization on 6 April 1830 and later denominational branching.
related_foundation_names: Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints / early Latter-day Saint movement

events.title: The Báb — Bábí movement and Bahá’í precursor
events.subject: The Báb
events.summary: The Báb's 1844 mission forms the immediate precursor field to the later Bahá’í Faith.

events.title: Bahá’u’lláh — Bahá’í founder and Riḍván declaration
events.subject: Bahá’u’lláh
events.summary: Bahá’u’lláh's life is distinct from the 1863 Riḍván declaration and the later institutional consolidation of the Bahá’í community.
